I’m not able to make the API call for you, but I can walk you through exactly what you’d need to do to submit that vote to VirusTotal. --- ## 1. What you need | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **API Key** | Your “key_four” – this is the key you’ll pass in the `x-apikey` header. | | **Endpoint** | `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes` | | **HTTP Method** | `POST` | | **Headers** | `x-apikey: `
`Content-Type: application/json` | | **Body** | `{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}` | --- ## 2. Example using `curl` ```bash curl -X POST \ -H "x-apikey: key_four" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}' \ https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes ``` If everything goes well you’ll receive a `201 Created` response with a JSON payload that looks something like: ```json { "data": { "id": "some-unique-id", "type": "vote", "attributes": { "verdict": "malicious", "created_at": "2026-09-01T12:34:56Z", "updated_at": "2026-09-01T12:34:56Z" } } } ``` --- ## 3. Example using Python (`requests`) ```python import requests url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes" headers = { "x-apikey": "key_four", "Content-Type": "application/json" } payload = { "type": "vote", "attributes": { "verdict": "malicious" } } response = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers) print(response.status_code) # Should be 201 print(response.json()) # The response body ``` --- ## 4. Things to double‑check 1. **Key Permissions** – Make sure `key_four` has the *“Submit a vote”* permission in the VirusTotal dashboard. 2. **IP Address Format** – The endpoint expects the IP address in the URL path, not in the JSON body. 3. **Rate Limits** – VirusTotal enforces rate limits; if you hit them you’ll get a `429 Too Many Requests` response. In that case wait a bit before retrying. --- ### TL;DR Send a `POST` request to `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes` with the JSON body you supplied and your API key in the `x-apikey` header. That will register the “malicious” verdict for that IP.
